snapshot.title: PWA install prompt on mobile web
snapshot.description: On mobile browsers, show a banner 2s after load prompting users to either open fullscreen mode or install the game as a PWA. Implemented in react-shell.js.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Banner appears on mobile non-PWA sessions after ~2s
Open Fullscreen button triggers Fullscreen API
Install App button triggers beforeinstallprompt on Android
Add to Home Screen button shows iOS share sheet instructions on iOS
Banner can be dismissed

changes.newValue:
1. Review current mobile banner logic in react-shell.js
2. Wire full mobile install actions (fullscreen, beforeinstallprompt, iOS A2HS guidance)
3. Ensure dismiss behavior and delayed appearance in non-PWA mobile
4. Update pwa spec doc and check ACs
